items_flat.title_en: OpenAI will end direct model access for SpaceX-owned Cursor on 12 Nov
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布結束對 SpaceX 旗下 Cursor 的模型直連，擬 11/12 切斷
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it notified SpaceX it will wind down the contract that supplies OpenAI models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff of 12 November 2026—the maximum notice in the change-of-control clause. It will not provide future models, including Astra. Cursor CEO Michael Truell said OpenAI models are about 5% of Cursor traffic and that talks continue; Anthropic separately said it will increase compute for Claude in Cursor.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已通知 SpaceX，將依控制權變更條款、以合約允許的最長通知期，於 2026 年 11 月 12 日結束向 Cursor 供應模型，且不提供含 Astra 在內的後續模型。Cursor 執行長 Michael Truell 稱 OpenAI 模型約佔流量 5%，雙方仍在溝通；Anthropic 則表示會加碼支援 Cursor 上的 Claude。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move turns a multi-model coding IDE into a more vertically integrated SpaceX/xAI surface and tests whether change-of-control clauses become standard weapons when labs acquire distribution. What remains unproven is whether developers actually migrate, and whether OpenAI’s ToS-risk claim holds if Cursor keeps a firewall from xAI training.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使原本中立的多模型編程工具更向 SpaceX／xAI 垂直整合，也測試「控制權變更即斷供」會否成為實驗室併購通路時的常規武器。開發者是否真的遷移、以及 Cursor 若與 xAI 訓練隔離後 OpenAI 的條款風險主張能否成立，目前都未證實。
items_flat.quote: We are making this choice because we cannot be confident that SpaceX will use our technology within our terms of service, based on our experience with Elon Musk's companies violating contracts.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們做出此決定，是因為根據過往馬斯克旗下公司違反合約的經驗，我們無法確信 SpaceX 會在我們的服務條款範圍內使用我們的技術。

items_flat.title_en: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over Claude training data
items_flat.title_zh: Sony Music 與 Warner Chappell 控告 Anthropic 以受著作權保護作品訓練 Claude
items_flat.summary_en: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music filed suit in the Northern District of California against Anthropic and co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann, alleging a campaign of torrenting, scraping and downloading copyrighted compositions to train Claude. Plaintiffs seek up to $150,000 per work plus damages for alleged removal of copyright-management information. Anthropic had not issued an official response in the sources retrieved.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sony Music Publishing 與 Warner Chappell Music 於加州北區聯邦法院起訴 Anthropic 及共同創辦人 Dario Amodei、Benjamin Mann，指控其以 BT、爬取與下載受著作權保護曲目訓練 Claude，並求償每件作品最高 15 萬美元及移除著作權管理資訊的損害賠償。檢索到的來源中尚未見到 Anthropic 官方回應。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coming after Anthropic’s earlier author/publisher settlement, the case extends the training-data fight from books into music catalogs and names founders personally—raising settlement leverage, not a resolved finding of liability. Whether courts treat lyrics scraped from licensed lyric sites as distinct from torrented books is the open legal question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此案接在 Anthropic 先前與作者／出版社和解之後，把訓練資料爭議從書籍延伸到音樂曲目，並點名創辦人個人，增加和解籌碼，但並非已認定侵權。法院是否將授權歌詞網站上的抓取與 BT 下載的書籍視為不同類型，仍是未決法律問題。
items_flat.quote: Defendants Anthropic and its founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann have conducted a brazen campaign of illegally torrenting, scraping, and downloading copyrighted works on a massive scale in order to develop, operate, and reap enormous profits from Anthropic's 'Claude' series of artificial intelligence ('AI') models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 被告 Anthropic 及其創辦人 Dario Amodei、Benjamin Mann 進行了一場大規模非法 BT、爬取與下載受著作權保護作品的行動，用以開發、營運並從 Anthropic 的 Claude 系列 AI 模型中獲取巨額利潤。

brief_en: A quiet Sunday after a noisy Friday: OpenAI will wind down Cursor model access by 12 Nov after SpaceX’s acquisition, citing ToS risk. Sony Music and Warner Chappell sued Anthropic over alleged lyric/training-data piracy. No new frontier model shipped in the window.
brief_zh: 週日偏靜。OpenAI 因 SpaceX 收購 Cursor，擬於 11/12 切斷模型直連；Sony／Warner Chappell 控告 Anthropic 以盜版歌詞與資料訓練 Claude。時窗內無新旗艦模型發布。
